subject: MedNovo security intake — SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & trust portal next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@mednovo.health>, Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@mednovo.health>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & initial security asks

Hi Alicia / Tom — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Scope: MedNovo is evaluating Redwood for conversational triage and summary features. You flagged HIPAA + GDPR constraints for EU patient data and cross-border processing.
- Primary asks you mentioned: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period), a bridge letter (temporary attestation if the reporting window doesn't cover your audit date), and access to our trust portal to fetch artifacts.
- Security contact: you said Alicia will own the intake and Tom will follow on legal/redlines.

Next steps we propose: 
1) Alicia — please share your vendor security questionnaire (or let us know if you'd prefer we push ours).
2) I’ll loop in our security team (Jonas) to scope the evidence exchange and provide the trust portal invite and upload instructions.
3) We’ll confirm whether a bridge letter is required vs. directly providing the latest Type II report.

If you can attach the questionnaire and a quick note on required retention/geo constraints (GDPR scope sheet if available), we’ll prioritize the handoff.

Thanks — Hannah

---
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@mednovo.health>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@mednovo.health>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & initial security asks

Thanks Hannah — great call. Attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire and a short spreadsheet that outlines the GDPR scope we need covered (EU-resident patient records flagged for processing).

Two clarifications from legal: 
- We need the latest SOC 2 Type II report covering at least the most recent 12-month period. If that report does not align with our contracting timeline, a signed bridge letter covering the gap will be required.
- Evidence retention: we’ll need to verify logging/audit retention for 1 year and that you offer options for data residency or contractual controls for EU data.

Can your security team confirm a timeline for portal invite + an expected list of artifacts you’ll provide? Also include a contact for SOC 2 questions (phone/email).

Attachments: mednovo_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (PDF), mednovo_gdpr_scope.xlsx (Excel)

Best —
Alicia Gomez
Head of Security & Compliance, MedNovo Health

Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report & trust portal next steps for MedNovo

Hi Alicia — thanks for the notes and the attachments. I’m on the security side; copying Grace who owns SOC artifact packaging. Quick plan and what we need from you: 

1) Trust portal invite: I’ve created a temporary invite for MedNovo. Please use the link below to create an account and securely upload the completed questionnaire (if you prefer to upload rather than email). Invite link: https://trust.redwood.com/portal/invite?token=abc123def

2) Artifacts we’ll provide when the portal is provisioned: 
   - Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted as appropriate)
   - Bridge letter template (signed by our Compliance Lead) if there’s a gap in coverage
   - System architecture diagram, logging/retention summary, and list of subservice organizations (if applicable)

3) Timeline: once we have the completed questionnaire and confirmation of your retention/GDPR rows, we can provision portal access within 48 business hours and upload the SOC report and bridge letter within 2 business days after access is validated.

4) For HIPAA: we can provide our BAA template. If you need a pre-signed BAA, flag that in the questionnaire or reply here and we’ll prioritize.

Security contact for SOC questions: Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.com, +1 650-555-2200). Compliance lead (for bridge letters): Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.com).

If you prefer SFTP instead of the portal we can provide an SFTP drop; portal is recommended for audit trail and granular permissions.

Jonas
Information Security, Redwood Inference
